Event

Golden Realm Expedition

You accidentally triggered a spell and found yourself in the legendary Golden Realm. Together with a girl who pilots a giant golemore, uncover the secrets buried deep within the rainforest!

Activity TypeGveGoldenRealmPhases2Duration7 or 8 days

Across all phases

Core Rewards

KukuFellow · KukuIxchelFamily · IxchelFigure [Inheritor]Player Costume · InheritorFigure [Divine Envoy Priestess]Player Costume · Divine Envoy Priestess
GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
Basic Gameplay

◆ During the Golden Realm Expedition event, you can team up to explore and take on challenges.

◆ Your aim is to progress, challenge patrons, and reach higher floors.

◆ At the start of the event, you must select five fellows to join you. Remember, changes cannot be made once confirmed for the duration of the event!

◆ When choosing fellows, the number of fellow types will determine different resonance effects activated. All power boost are only effective in the event.

Team Rules

◆ During team formation, you can create, join, leave, or disband teams.

◆ Once the event begins, you cannot leave or disband teams.

◆ Creating a team is free the first time; subsequent creations require crystals.

Advancement

◆ Each exploration consumes dice, randomizing a number between 1-6 to determine your steps forward.

◆ Dice regenerate over time, but stop at the maximum limit. You can also restore them by using Energy Corn or a Plate of Corn.

◆ During exploration, you may encounter enemies, Golemore EXP, Boost Gems, Golemore Workshop, Support Flags, which grant Super Achv Points.

◆ Get enough Super Achv Points to claim rewards in Achievements and Golden Realm Pass.

◆ Occasionally, a fork in the road will appear, requiring you to choose a path. Once chosen, the other route cannot be taken, but both lead to the same destination.

◆ Don't worry, the fork will eventually lead back to the same destination.

◆ Teammates' map progress is not shared, allowing independent management of routes.

Enemies

◆ Each area features normal enemies and elite enemies who will challenge you upon encounter.

◆ Deploy 5 fellows for a 5v5 battle in a challenge. If you can't win, rearranging your fellows' position may help.

◆ In a 5v5 battle, winning 3 out of 5 matches secures victory in the challenge, granting golds and rewards.

◆ If you fail, you can retry or give up the challenge. Giving up grants no golds or rewards, but you can still proceed.

Patron

◆ Defeat normal or elite enemies to earn gold. Once you get enough golds, the patron will appear.

◆ Defeating the patron grants generous rewards and allows progression to the next area.

◆ If you can't defeat the patron, purchasing a bundle to boost your power for a retry, or choose to give up the challenge.

◆ Giving up the challenge allows progression to the next area with no rewards.

Golemore Workshop

◆ When encountering a Golemore Workshop during your progression, 3 random golemore skills will appear.

◆ Select a golemore skill. The effects of the same skill can be stacked.

◆ Golemore skills take effect globally in the event and are cleared after it ends.

Support Flag

◆ During the exploration, you may encounter a Support Flag, allowing you to choose 1 fellow from your team to assist you.

◆ When challenging normal enemies, elite enemies, and patrons, you can deploy assisting fellows if your current team lacks sufficient power.

◆ Only 1 assistance fellow can be deployed per challenge, so choose wisely.

◆ Each assistance fellow has a limited number of uses. Once exhausted, they are removed from the assistance pool and must be invited again by encountering a Support Flag.

◆ If you prefer not to invite fellows of teammates, you can forgo the invitation for certain rewards.

Team Altar

◆ Collect Altar EXP as you progress. Your team's experience accumulates to level up the Team Altar.

◆ Team Altar periodically produces Boost Gems. The higher the level, the more gems produced.

◆ The altar can store Boost Gems for up to 48 hours. Once storage is full, production will pause. Remember to claim them in time.

◆ Use these gems to boost your fellows' power during the event for better challenges against enemies.

◆ Purchasing the Premium Pass grants access to Advanced Boost Gems through point accumulation, enabling more efficient fellow enhancement.

◆ Note that transcenders from other teams can challenge your team members through plunders.

◆ If they succeed, they will obtain a certain amount of Altar EXP. Regardless of the outcome, our Altar EXP will not be reduced.

Lost Cargo

◆ Chubby Ginger has lost cargo on the field. Transcenders can assist in finding it during exploration.

◆ Once the cargo is found, Chubby Ginger will offer precious items at a discount for all teammates to purchase.

Leaderboards & Rewards

◆ The event features both an overall and a daily leaderboard.

◆ The daily leaderboard resets daily, with rankings based on Boost Gem consumptions of individuals and teams.

◆ Enhance fellows by consuming Boost Gems to improve ranking. If Advanced Boost Gems are used, they will be converted into Boost Gem consumption at a fixed ratio for leaderboard calculations.

◆ The overall leaderboard is settled at the end of the event. Rankings are determined separately by the amount of gold collected by individuals and by teams.

◆ After the leaderboards have been calculated, rewards can be claimed based on ranks.

◆ Unclaimed ranking rewards will be sent to you via mail.

In-Event Power

◆ Final Power in the Event = Fellow's Own Power * (1 + In-Event Fellow Boost Bonus) * (1 + Type Bonus + In-Event Golemore Skill Bonus + UR Character of current event Bonus) + In-Event Golemore Screw Bonus + Power Bundle Bonus.
